premise_corrections: Forwarding --max-turns alone CANNOT fix the budget price: the runner's dry run never reads cfg.max_turns (run_longrun.py:2079, :2121-2127). Forwarding was implemented for argv parity, but the ticket needed one scoping line inside stage_budget as well -- still stage_budget only, no runner change.

Editing cell.py does NOT change the harness digest (cell.py is not in HARNESS_FILES). harness_sha256_before == harness_sha256_after == a3fa2ee0...; the pin is stale from a grade_v5.py move by another card, not 'by design' of this unit.
assumptions: The scoping line reads the runner's own per-arm 'N=' line so that a future runner that honours --max-turns turns the subtraction into a no-op (priced_n == n_turns) rather than a double discount.
Digest requests and tool follow-up allowances are deliberately NOT scaled down: over-pricing is safe, under-pricing a commit is not. Only turns that provably will not run are removed.

The G2 end-to-end allow/refuse evidence uses an argv-recording stub runner (as tests/test_cell_gates.py does) so no live runner could ever be reached; the price proofs use the real runner with --budget 1, which aborts at stage 3/7 before any request.
